items.title: Marriott International (MAR)’s Middle East Headwind Eases, but War Risks Remain
items.summary: Marriott International, Inc. (NASDAQ:MAR)’s Middle East business showed a meaningful improvement in July, with revenue per available room (RevPAR) declining 12% year over year, a sharp improvement from the 43% decline in the second quarter.
